Public Finance Committee
Agenda

Meeting: 26th meeting
Venue: Committee Room 10
Date: 27 October 2026 (Tuesday)
Time: 9:30 am

1. Other matters.

2. Discussion of the information received from the Maldives Customs Service in connection with the matter submitted to the committee stating that Maldives Customs Service staff working at Velana International Airport are not rotated, that some air cargo goods are cleared without being scanned, and that goods imported duty-free for sale at the airport's duty-free shops are sold at those companies' shops in other areas.

3. Sharing with the committee information sent by institutions in connection with the committee's reports;
➢ Letters sent by the Anti-Corruption Commission regarding the "Report on the committee's review of the special audit report (2021-2023) of the branches and projects run by Fenaka Corporation Limited in Addu City";
